title: Portrait key visual: one-point corridor, red band with a vertical title, collage objects, copy block on paper
use: Poster or key visual of a fictional work in the style: architecture top, title band right, copy bottom left, collage around but never over copy.

tag_ja.default: 『扉は閉じた。廊下が、またひとつ伸びた。』

credit.default: 原创动画　©夜想回廊制作委员会

collage{i}.note: cut-out object with alpha (png/webp); 0 main object top left, 1-3 secondary; drawn only when filled

relations: Copy block on paper bottom left on one shared left line; the title column lives in the red band.
Collage objects frame the corridor and never cover copy (browser rule collage-cover).
decoration: Screentone band at the foot with paper plates under the credits.

provenance.corpus: Nocturne Corridor (夜想回廊) experiment: our own original fictional anime set in the shinbo style pack's grammar, first pass and reviewed final
provenance.method: Geometry taken from the final round's HTML/CSS as fractions of W and H; text sizes and colours chosen so the final passed the browser check (contrast with text hidden, ink overlap, collage alpha, off-canvas). All copy is original.
measured: first pass: a key sticker over the tagline and the reading (2 covered); 2 contrast failures on the screentone band
final: key moved to the corridor, paper plates under the credits; passes
provenance.summary: Nocturne Corridor poster first pass and final
